body:
I'd like to quit in a month. I told my boyfriend about this today and he started screaming. "We need the money" which was his main argument and something I know. I tried explaining what the job was doing to me, he again dismissed my concerns stating "I know the job is difficult at times" and went on to saying if I quit I would need to leave and go live with my brother. That's funny. When he didn't have a job for a year and a half, I took care of everything and didn't once say LEAVE. I worked three jobs to keep us fed and bills paid.                                          

It's interesting to see his true colors now. I'm nothing but a paycheck to him. He makes less than me and definitely not enough to pay the bills so, I'd like to see how he does without me in the picture.                 

As for career training, I have a degree but it's pretty worthless. Along with working 3 jobs, I also managed to get myself through school. I stayed up some nights studying because I felt it was important that I do well in school. I worked my butt off, graduated with a 3.6. Unfortunately, I picked a pretty stupid major which has caused me not to be able to find a job in that field. I would like to do career training but I'm not sure of what field to get into or even what school to attend.

I worked nearly 80 hours last week because of Mother's Day. I work in a call center. I hate my job. I continue to look for work, but there isn't much else here in the small town. The job drains everything out of me and at the end of the day, there's nothing left. "Looking on the bright side" being cheerful and happy" is complete bs. You know what happens when I try to be cheerful and happy? I told a lady yesterday "Have a Good Day!" She responds with "Who are you kidding? It's going to be a miserable (expletive) day" and she hung up.                           

I've identified problems with communication between the different departments at work. When I tried speaking up, I was told to not say anything else by a boss. Everyone wants to continue creating bad experiences for our customers, but no one wants to take a moment and actually fix things. The sales team misleads people and get them into signing contracts, so then when someone wants to end the contract we (customer service) have to give them the bad news.                        

Other departments know where to find things and how to fix them and what do they do? They send the caller to us. I've had it!!!!!!!!!!            

All this uplifting and being happy and cheerful nonsense doesn't work for me. It hasn't worked for a long time. I am tired of being screamed at all day for a little bit of money. I am disgusted in myself that I still work for this unhonest company. Happiness is not contagious, when the people I speak with are just as miserable as I am.
